My Wikimedia activities mainly focus on edits and corrections to Wikipedia pages related to my area of interest, adding cited informations, photography, Commons, youth-related projects, and topics related to music and culture.

In this report, I will share my experiences, observations, and highlights from Wikimania 2026. I will also describe the events I enjoyed the most during the conference.

Wikimania 2026 in Paris was my first Wikimania. I had attended other Wikimedia events before, but this was my first time experiencing Wikimania itself. During the conference, I joined sessions related to my interests, volunteered as a photographer at some activities, met new people and spent time again with friends I already knew from the CEE community. Some of the sessions also gave me new ideas about how I want to contribute in the future, especially through photography, youth activities and music.

Picture humanity in a boat being swept down a raging river, praying there is no Niagara Falls ahead. Or imagine standing with the pioneering physicists in 1942 before they triggered the first self-sustaining nuclear fission chain reaction beneath a Chicago stadium.

These were two of the analogies used this week by Prof Robert Trager, an expert in the nascent field of AI governance, to describe the perilous but potential-filled moment the world stands at with accelerating artificial intelligence.

title: Electing the CEE Hub Steering Committee: What we built and what we learned
content:
On 2 September 2026, the new Wikimedia CEE Hub Steering Committee began its term, following several months of nominations, eligibility checks, community engagement and voting. Eight members were elected: four by individual community members and four by CEE affiliates, and two more were later co-opted.

But this election was also a first test of putting the CEE Hub’s governance model into practice. We had the rules; we still needed to build the process around them. That meant establishing an independent Electoral Commission, translating eligibility rules into practice, working with two different electorates, and building Fala, our own voting tool on Wikimedia Toolforge.

The election had two constituencies: individual CEE community members and CEE affiliates, each electing four members. That made eligibility one of the first practical challenges. Community voters had to meet both Wikimedia activity requirements and demonstrate a connection to the CEE community, while affiliates had to designate representatives to vote on their behalf.

title: More than a campaign: the measurable impact of Celebrate Women 2026
content:
Imagine a world in which every woman on the planet finds a representative and diverse sum of all human knowledge about women+* available on Wikipedia and on the internet. This is what the Celebrate Women campaign has been trying to accomplish since 2022. 

Every March, during Women’s History Month and in celebration of International Women’s Day (March 8th), the Wikimedia community gathers both online and in person to edit and improve the content available on Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia projects about women+. The editing happens as part of edit-a-thons, workshops, training sessions, and many other types of gatherings, which are spread around the world, with events on every continent. 

For 2026, we had one of the biggest campaigns so far. Considering all the gatherings globally, we had 112 events listed on the official page, which were divided into these sections: 

  • Global: 21 events
  • Africa: 20 events
  • Asia: 15 events
  • Europe: 38 events
  • Latin America: 12 events
  • Middle East: 1 event
  • North America: 3 events
  • Oceania: 2 events

title: Avoin lähdekoodi tuo vaihtoehdon käyttövaltuushallintaan – CSIT Finland mukaan COSSin verkostoon
content:
COSSin verkosto on laajentunut CSIT Finlandin liittyessä mukaan yhteisöjäseneksi!

Organisaatioiden toimintaympäristöt muuttuvat yhä monimutkaisemmiksi. Käyttäjiä, järjestelmiä, pilvipalveluita ja erilaisia digitaalisia identiteettejä on enemmän, samalla kun tietoturvaa, tietosuojaa ja käyttöoikeuksien hallittavuutta koskevat vaatimukset kasvavat. Erityisesti korkeakouluissa ja julkishallinnossa identiteettien hallinnan on pystyttävä palvelemaan hyvin erilaisia käyttäjäryhmiä ja muuttuvia käyttöoikeustarpeita.

CSIT Finland Oy on liittynyt COSS ry:n jäseneksi vahvistaakseen yhteistyötä suomalaisen avoimen lähdekoodin ekosysteemin kanssa. Tuomme verkostoon erityisesti identiteetin- ja käyttövaltuushallinnan osaamista sekä kokemusta vaativien IAM- ja IGA-ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta ja jatkuvista palveluista.

Toimiva identiteetinhallinta huolehtii käyttäjän digitaalisesta identiteetistä ja käyttövaltuuksista koko niiden elinkaaren ajan. Kun henkilö aloittaa organisaatiossa, vaihtaa tehtävää tai poistuu, käyttöoikeuksien pitäisi muuttua hallitusti ja mahdollisimman automaattisesti.

title: Microsoft 365 -tilimurrot lisääntyivät elokuussa
content:
Microsoft 365 -tilimurtojen määrä kasvoi elokuussa, kertoo Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskus. Nopealla reagoinnilla voidaan vähentää tilimurron seurauksia.

Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskuksen mukaan Microsoft 365 -tilimurrot alkavat usein tunnustenkalastelulla. Käyttäjä houkutellaan luovuttamaan kirjautumistietonsa tai hyväksymään kirjautuminen rikollisen puolesta. Kaapatulla tilillä rikollinen voi lukea sähköposteja, varastaa tietoja, lähettää uusia kalasteluviestejä ja tehdä petoksia uhrin nimissä.

“Elokuussa Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskukselle ilmoitettiin eniten Microsoft 365-tilimurtoja tämän vuoden aikana. Tunnustenkalastelun vaikutuksia voidaan merkittävästi vähentää nopealla reagoinnilla, vahvalla tunnistautumisella ja epäilyttävien viestien ilmoittamisella”, kertoo Kyberturvallisuuskeskuksen tietoturva-asiantuntija Roni Kokkola.

Kalasteluviesti voi näyttää tulevan tutulta lähettäjältä

Tunnustenkalasteluviestit voivat sisältää linkkejä, liitteitä tai QR-koodeja. Viesti voi myös näyttää tulevan tutulta lähettäjältä, sillä rikolliset hyödyntävät kaapattuja sähköpostitilejä ja aitoja pilvipalveluita tehdäkseen viesteistä uskottavampia.

title: SheSaid 2026: The Global Story Continues, One Voice at a Time
content:
The #SheSaid campaign 2026 officially launched on 1 September and will run until 31 December 2026. Now in its seventh edition, #SheSaid continues to grow as a global campaign, bringing together participants from around the world to add and improve women’s voices on Wikimedia projects.

As part of Wiki Loves Women, an initiative of Wiki in Africa, #SheSaid works to address the gender gap on Wikiquote by making women’s words, experiences and perspectives more visible and accessible.

This year is particularly special: Wiki Loves Women is celebrating 10 years of making women visible in the world’s largest open knowledge ecosystem. #SheSaid is part of this decade-long journey, building on the contributions of thousands of participants who have helped bring women’s voices into the Wikimedia movement and beyond.

Six editions. More than 42k contributions. 22 languages from English to Assamese. More than 25 communities from Indonesia to Italy, Ghana and beyond. . 

#SheSaid is more than just the numbers. It is a story of people coming together across languages, countries and cultures, united by one purpose: to make women’s voices more visible.

title: The Trump White House’s fetish for gamer culture has moved up a level with new arcade
content:
A string of distractions on the US government’s own website invite you to catch pixelated migrants – showing gaming’s potential to be nastily weaponised

The Trump White House on Thursday released a horrible little propaganda arcade via its website, a collection of nasty riffs on popular games. Wrapped in the cutesy, nostalgic aesthetic of early-90s pixel art, these mindless fascist diversions are harmless-looking, but their intent is stomach-turning: this is the appropriation of play in service of propaganda. It’s just the latest in a series of attempts from Trump’s administration to use video game memes and imagery to further its messaging.

title: CodeRefinery-työpaja
content:
Kirjoitatko koodia ja hallinnoitko tutkimusaineistoja? Meneekö sinulla liikaa aikaa työläisiin manuaalisiin tehtäviin? Onko oman tai muiden vanhemman koodin ymmärtäminen ja uudelleenkäyttö hankalaa?

Tule mukaan CodeRefinery-työpajaan 22.–24.9. ja 29.9.–1.10.2026 klo 11–16 EEST (Helsingin aikaa).

  • Git-versionhallinta, painopisteenä yhteistyö eikä pelkästään komentorivin käyttö
  • Toistettavuus: koodin valmistelu niin, että sinä ja muut voivat käyttää sitä myös tulevaisuudessa
  • Miten voit saada koodillesi ansaitsemaasi tunnustusta ja mahdollistaa sen uudelleenkäytön
  • Tutkimusohjelmistojen dokumentointi
  • Generatiivisen tekoälyn vastuullinen käyttö ohjelmoinnin tukena
  • Toimivan koodin rikkoutumisen estäminen – sekä itseltäsi että muilta
  • Modulaarinen ohjelmistokehitys: koodin osien uudelleenkäytön helpottaminen

    • Tässä käytännönläheisessä työpajassa tutustutaan työkaluihin ja tekniikoihin, joiden avulla voit kirjoittaa FAIR-periaatteiden (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) mukaisempaa tutkimuskoodia.

    Työpaja ei ole ohjelmoinnin alkeiskurssi. Eniten hyödyt, jos sinulla on jo kokemusta ohjelmoinnista jollakin ohjelmointikielellä.

  • Varmista, että työpaja sopii sinulle CodeRefineryn työpajasivulta

title: Growth in Chains: EU Value Chain Productivity and its Slowdown
content: We study Europe’s post-2008 productivity slowdown using novel total factor productivity (TFP) measures that follow production beyond individual industries in global value chains (GVCs). We collect a newset of stylized facts: (1) the slowdown is broad-based, with productivity growth weakening both in final-producer industries and in upstream industries; (2) the staggered entry into force of bilateral investment treaties with China is followed by higher value-chain TFP and greater business-intangible investment; while (3) the gains associated with technology intangibles are weak. We use these facts to discipline a stylized two-region general-equilibrium model with business capabilities, technology-related knowledge, and cross-border knowledge spillovers. The calibration supports a two-stage interpretation of Europe’s experience: (1) sizeable initial integration gains because accumulated business capabilities convert market access into productivity, and (2) later losses when technology improvements are converted into productivity more effectively elsewhere.

title: Pohjois-Savon liitto lanseeraa Yrittäjän päivänä uuden innovaatiopalkinnon
content:
Pohjois-Savoon perustetaan uusi Kultainen Jousi -innovaatiopalkinto. Vuosittain jaettavalla tunnustuksella nostetaan esiin pohjoissavolaisia yrityksiä, jotka ovat onnistuneet viemään tutkimusta, kehitystyötä ja uusia ideoita käytännön ratkaisuiksi ja liiketoiminnaksi.

Ensimmäisen palkinnon haku avataan valtakunnallisena Yrittäjän päivänä 5. syyskuuta 2026.

Palkinto on saanut nimensä Pohjois-Savon vaakunassa olevasta viritetystä käsijousesta. Kultainen Jousi symboloi suuntaa, voimaa ja kykyä tähdätä kohti uutta – juuri sitä, mitä Pohjois-Savossa tehdään panostamalla vahvasti tutkimukseen, kehittämiseen ja innovaatioihin. Myös aluekehitysvaroilla on rakennettu määrätietoisesti tutkimus- ja kehittämisympäristöjä, joissa syntyy uusia tuotteita ja palveluita.

title: The 2026 European Union Prize for Literature anthology is out
content:
“European stories”, the 2026 European Union Prize for Literature (EUPL) anthology presents the 14 shortlisted EUPL authors from 2026 and showcases excerpts from their nominated books both in the original languages and in English translation.

The main purpose of the anthology is to present these 14 emerging and talented writers to the European publishing world, and to get them translated into other European languages. Some of the 2026 shortlisted authors have already signed translation deals following the prize ceremony on 29th of May at the Warsaw Museum of Modern Art.

The anthology will be distributed at major book fairs like Gothenburg and Frankfurt. The e-book version is also available online on the Office of Publications website for anyone to read.

The anthology features stories from the 14 shortlisted authors of the 2026 European Union Prize for Literature.

Link to the Publications Office of the EU.

The prize is an annual initiative of the Creative Europe programme. It started in 2009 to recognise the best European emerging authors and celebrate the linguistic diversity and excellence of literature in countries participating in the Creative Europe programme.

title: Makumuistoja mummolasta, huoltovarmuutta ja elävää maaseutua
content:
Tänään syyskuun neljäntenä vietetään suomalaisen ruoan päivää. Parhaaseen sadonkorjuuaikaan onkin sopiva hetki seisahtaa lähimmän pellon pieleen hetkeksi pohtimaan aihetta.

Ruoka on monitahoinen asia, kovin paljon muutakin kuin kehon polttoainetta. Työpaikkaruokalassa torstaina tuoksuva hernesoppa voi kiidättää makumuistoissa hetkessä lapsuuteen kotikylän laskiaistapahtumaan tai vaikkapa varusmiespalvelusajan pakista lusikoitujen annosten äärelle. Lähes jokainen osaa nimetä ruokalajin, joka oli oman äidin bravuuri, tai joka kuului kiinteänä osana mummolassa vietettyihin hetkiin.

Täysinä notkuvat ruokakauppojen hyllyt ovat arkipäivää, ja jonkinlainen kriisi on tulilla, jos suosikkituotteen kohdalta löytyykin tyhjä kolo.

content:
Kotiseutuliiton kaupunkityön jaosto järjestää jo perinteisen Kaupunkipaahtimon tänä vuonna webinaarina, kaupunginosatoiminnan tulevaisuusfoorumina.

Foorumin tavoitteena on tarjota aineksia kaupunkitoiminnan vetovoiman lisäämiseen ja tukea toimijoiden ja yhdistysten pitkän tähtäimen strategista suunnittelua. Näitä lähestytään orientoitumalla tulevaan: Miten uusia toimijoita rekrytoidaan ja saadaan toimintaan mukaan? Miten heidän hyvinvoinnistaan huolehditaan? Kuinka tehdään alueellista yhteistyötä?

Tulevaisuusfoorumi järjestetään webinaarina tiistaina 6. lokakuuta klo 17.30-19.30.

Webinaarissa kuullaan asiantuntija-alustus ja case-esimerkkejä erilaisista kaupunginosista. Kansalaisareenan vapaaehtoistoiminnan asiantuntija Satu Puolitaival esittelee tuoreen tutkimuksen tuloksia ja kertoo vapaaehtoisten rekrytoinnista ja hyvinvoinnista. Tampereen, Helsingin ja Espoon kaupunginosista kuultavien tapausesimerkkien jälkeen osallistujat pääsevät keskustelemaan ja tuomaan omia kokemuksiaan osaksi illan antia.

title: Intresserad av internationell praktik?
content:
Är du nyutexaminerad eller på slutrakan av dina studier? Vill du spendera ett år utomlands och skaffa dig arbetserfarenhet, kontakter och minnen för livet? Då kan internationell praktik vara något för dig. Mellan den 15 och 30 september finns åtta praktikplatser att söka.

På den här sidan kan du läsa mer om alla praktikplatser. Du kan söka stipendierna två gånger per år, i september(15-30.9) och i mars(15-31.3). Ansökningstiderna under våren och hösten gäller olika praktikorganisationer.

Då du ansöker om internationell praktik ansöker du om ett stipendium för oavlönad praktik vid någon av de åtta organisationerna som finns listade nedan. Om du blir antagen så får du ett månatligt skattefritt stipendium, men står själv för dina boendeutgifter, försäkringar och resor till och från praktikplatsen.

I september 2026 kan du ansöka om en praktikplats vid:

  • Finlands institut i Tokyo
  • Finlands kulturinstitut i New York

content:

Seminaarissa lauantaina 3. lokakuuta käsittelemme Sally Salmisen elämää ja kirjallista tuotantoa. Iltapäivän aikana tutustumme Katrina-klassikon kirjoittajaan luentojen, keskustelujen ja ääneen luettujen tekstikatkelmien kautta.

Seminaari valottaa Salmisen matkaa Ahvenanmaalta New Yorkiin ja edelleen kansainväliseksi kirjailijaksi, jonka tuotanto on jättänyt pysyvän jäljen pohjoismaiseen kirjallisuuteen. Salmisen kertomukset siirtolaisuudesta, yhteiskuntaluokista, naisten elinehdoista ja ihmisen vapaudenkaipuusta tuntuvat yhtä ajankohtaisilta tänään kuin kirjoitushetkellään. Hänen elämänsä ja teostensa kautta seminaari tarkastelee kirjailijuutta, joka koskettaa ja inspiroi yhä uusia lukijasukupolvia.

title: Seven more “Engagement and Collaboration” projects started
content:
ECHOES is pleased to announce that a further seven projects funded by the Cascading Grants programme under Call 2, “Engagement and Collaboration” have started.

The Call invited applications from Cultural Heritage institutions (CHIs) to help raise awareness of the Cultural Heritage Cloud and grow its community, to support skills development and capacity building, with a focus on small and medium-sized CHIs. A variety of approaches was encouraged such as training seminars, help desks, promotional materials along with applicants own proposals. Further details about all the projects are to be found on the Second Call Awards page.

The seven new projects:

Heritage in Motion
Scope: Provide training and toolkits for Audiovisual (AV) collections, organise a symposium to share practices and build the ECCCH AV community.
Geographic region(s): Pan-Europe
Target organisations: AV heritage institutions.

EMPOWER-CH
Scope: Dissemination, consultation and peer- exchange activities to make the ECCCH more accessible to museum and GLAM professionals.
Geographic region(s): Italy, pan-Europe
Target organisations: Museums and cultural heritage institutions.

title: Why Inventing Color TV Was So Difficult
content: Many who read this will remember watching television on a black-and-white set at some point in their lives. Fewer will remember doing so because only black-and-white sets existed. Of course, your own experience will depend upon your country of origin. The United States began the transition to color television in 1953, and more than half of its population owned color sets less than twenty years thereafter. France’s stations started to change over in 1967, and the last one did so in 1983. South Korea, where I live, started its own regular color broadcasts in 1980, though at that point, those from the American Forces Network, Japan, and even North Korea could already be tuned in for years.

title: Machine Capabilities at a Human Scale: Get to Know the Revolution Crossroads Initiative
content:
For the 2026 American semiquincentennial year, the Library of Congress is working with the Smithsonian Institution to look at how artificial intelligence technologies can help make new discoveries about history. Dubbed “Revolution Crossroads,” the initiative aims to demonstrate what AI could do to enable new insights and explorations with collections.

An introductory video from Inside Smithsonian Digital and the Library of Congress asks, “Can AI Help Historians?” It explains how leaders, curators, and technology experts are coming together to explore and explain AI’s capabilities to augment learning, research, and discovery.

While much is known about the Revolutionary Era, even a quick look through the Nation’s collections reveals that much remains to be unearthed. Bringing together large repositories with different types of materials, 3D objects, artworks, historic newspapers, and archival materials, may reveal patterns and connections never understood before. And expanding access and building a data bridge across our institutions may give many others new ways to examine these collections and discover connections across them.

title: Guidance for Indigenous Collections and Data
content:
Creative Commons (CC) is happy to announce the launch of a new publication entitled Guidance for Indigenous Collections and Indigenous Data: Recommendations from Creative Commons and Local Contexts. This publication is the result of a collaboration with Local Contexts, as both organizations share commitments to equitable knowledge sharing, proper attribution, and respect for diverse cultural and community protocols. It aims to support cultural heritage institutions (CHIs) in navigating the complex legal, ethical, and cultural issues regarding open access to Indigenous heritage and associated data. 

In this blog post, we offer some background to the publication, share some hot takes from the launch webinar, and invite you to learn more about this topic.

title: The OpenAI – Hugging Face case: a story of model behaviour and security threats
content:
Author: Laura Masaracchia

The AI and cyber community has recently been shaken by a scandal involving OpenAI and HuggingFace. The news came out on July 16th, when Hugging Face (a well-known online platform that hosts open source AI models) reported attacks against their servers from unknown sources [1]. OpenAI (one of the biggest AI companies, creators of ChatGPT) confirmed their models were behind the attack on July 21st [2]. The two firms started collaborating to investigate the incident, gradually releasing information to the public. 

What happened

The incident in brief 

OpenAI was testing two of its newest models to check for their cyber attack capabilities. These kinds of tests are typically carried in virtually isolated environments. During the test, the models found a flaw in a third party software, exploited it to get access to the open internet, and then, once out, they searched for a place that most likely held the answers to the test – and targeted Hugging Face to retrieve them.

content:

It has been reported that the department declined individual reporters from  The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg News and Asheville Watchdog to cover the gathering of the world’s most powerful countries in Asheville. “The decision to exclude individual reporters is the latest example of the Trump administration restricting access to certain journalists,” reported The New York Times.

In a September 3 letter to G20 leaders, the M20 coalition said. “This inexplicable exclusion sends a chilling message to news organizations and raises legitimate questions about their ability to cover the G20 Miami summit in December.”

title: Why Macron’s space summit risks blowing up on the launchpad
content:
PARIS — French President Emmanuel Macron’s international space summit is not going according to plan. 

On Friday, the French leader’s office downplayed the last-minute decision by American space giants, including Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origin, to skip the event, made under pressure from the White House.

The U.S. snub is only one of several challenges facing the gathering on Wednesday and Thursday in the French capital. About 120 international delegations have been invited, with Chinese officials expected to attend.

Six participants with first-hand knowledge of the summit’s organization described it to POLITICO as a poorly coordinated event with an unclear outcome. They were granted anonymity to discuss sensitive matters. 

“It’s falling behind schedule, it hasn’t really been coordinated with the major players in the European space sector, and it’s not entirely clear what its purpose is,” said a senior space expert involved in the summit’s preparation. 

“And now that the White House has effectively decided to use it against Emmanuel Macron, it’s becoming even more awkward — it shows that, from a diplomatic standpoint, they didn’t do what they should have done,” they added.
snippet: PARIS — French President Emmanuel Macron’s international space summit is not going according to plan.

title: Russia: ECtHR decision to strike out more than 800 complaints denies victims truth, justice and reparation and should be reversed
content:
Reacting to the decision by the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) to strike 879 applications against Russia from its list of cases on grounds of their lesser importance to case law and a lack of resources for their examination, Marie Struthers, Amnesty International’s Eastern Europe and Central Asia Director, said:

“The European Court of Human Rights’ decision is deeply disappointing. It deprives hundreds of individuals of what for many of them is their last hope of seeing justice for the violations they have suffered.

“The decision to deny these victims their day in court cannot be justified by Russia’s refusal to execute Court judgments, or the fact that the remaining applications raise no novel questions of law, or restraints on resources. This decision should be reversed and the cases brought back on the Court’s docket.

title: Maternity leave is expanding in Bangladesh, but garment workers still struggle for childcare
content:
“The breastfeeding room was always there. But there was no-one to bring my baby to me.”

Originally published on Global Voices

Workers at a garment factory in Gazipur, Bangladesh. Image via Flickr by Solidarity Center. CC BY 2.0.

In April 2026, Bangladesh’s Parliament amended the country’s labour law, extending maternity benefits for eligible workers from 112 to 120 days, or approximately four months. Yet for many women in the country’s garment factories, the harder question begins when that leave ends: Who cares for their babies while they return to shifts that may last 10 to 14 hours?

The pressure is not limited to garment workers. Across Bangladesh, working mothers often depend on relatives or informal care networks, while affordable, quality childcare remains limited. The International Labour Organization (ILO) has noted that Bangladesh’s traditional family-dependent care system is under pressure as patterns of work and migration change. For low-income workers with long or unpredictable hours, that gap can be especially difficult.

title: Hong Kong Misuses Colonial-era Law to Violate Rights
content:
Organizing a group to help people in distress used to be something Hong Kong people could do without fear. Not anymore.

On September 3, the Hong Kong Court of Appeal affirmed the conviction of five 612 Humanitarian Fund trustees for failing to register the fund under the Societies Ordinance. It’s just the latest example of the government weaponizing colonial-era laws to dismantle civil society organizations.

The 612 Fund was established in 2019 through public donations to cover medical and legal expenses for demonstrators arrested during the pro-democracy protests. It ceased operations in 2021. The following year, its five trustees—including Cardinal Joseph Zen, the barrister Margaret Ng, and the singer Denise Ho—were fined HK$4,000 (US$510) for failing to register as a society. Separately, they were also arrested under the newly adopted National Security Law for alleged “foreign collusion”; that case remains open.

title: The Limit Of Coercion: Israel’s Strategic Delusion
content:
By Alon Ben-Meir*

NEW YORK | 4 September 2026 (IDN) — Comparative conflict analysis reveals clear conditions under which weaker actors concede. The Palestinian case meets none of them, underscoring Israel’s strategic futility in expecting capitulation in the absence of a political settlement.

The asymmetry of power between states and non-state actors—or between dominant governments and weaker national movements—has defined many of the world’s most enduring conflicts. From Northern Ireland to Afghanistan, from Algeria to Sri Lanka, history offers repeated examples of struggles in which a materially and militarily weaker party ultimately abandons its fight. Yet such outcomes are neither inevitable nor uniform. They arise under specific, identifiable conditions. Understanding these conditions is critical not only for interpreting past conflicts but for assessing ongoing ones—particularly the Israeli–Palestinian conflict, where expectations of eventual Palestinian capitulation to Israel are deeply misplaced.

title: UN votes to adopt new world map that shows Africa’s true scale
content:
Togo-sponsored resolution called to phase out traditional map that depicts continent as similar size to Greenland

The United Nations has voted to adopt a resolution for the world to formally phase out the traditional Mercator map of the globe in favour of one that more accurately displays Africa’s size.

In a session at its headquarters in New York, the UN general assembly officially retired the 16th-century Mercator projection in favour of one based on the more accurate 2018 Equal Earth design.

title: Europe’s veto problem: Can the EU learn to act without unanimity?
content:
For decades, unanimity in foreign policy has been both a safeguard of national sovereignty and one of the European Union’s greatest weaknesses.

It ensures that no member state can be forced to support a foreign-policy decision it considers fundamentally contrary to its national interests. At the same time, it gives every government the ability to prevent the EU from acting – even when the other 26 countries are ready to move forward.

Now France and Germany want to change that balance.

According to a letter, 11 EU member states are calling for a series of measures designed to make decision-making on foreign and security policy faster and more effective. Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Romania, Spain and Sweden have signed the document.

The letter was also circulated to the foreign ministers of the remaining EU member states, according to Italy’s ANSA news agency.

At the heart of the initiative is a proposal to make greater use of qualified majority voting (QMV) instead of unanimity in selected areas of foreign and security policy.

That may sound like a technical institutional reform. It is not.

title: Lack of Oversight Fuels Power Sector Corruption, Iraqi Lawmaker Says
content:
An Iraqi lawmaker has blamed a systemic lack of public procurement oversight for widespread corruption in the country's electricity contracts, revealing that parliament is drafting new legislation to bridge the regulatory gap.

Speaking to OCCRP, Taha Al-Difai, head of the Iraqi Parliament's Integrity Committee, said the absence of government oversight on public energy contracts allowed violations to proliferate unchecked.

“In the past, there was oversight provided by inspectors' offices, but currently, such oversight is absent… contracting procedures proceed easily without supervision,” Al-Difai said.

He noted that the Federal Board of Supreme Audit currently reviews contracts only after they have been signed. To resolve the issue, Al-Difai said parliament plans to enact an “internal oversight” law allowing contracts to be audited prior to signing. The draft is scheduled for a first reading next week.

He also called for amendments to Iraq’s financial disclosure rules to broaden scrutiny over the sources of public officials’ wealth and property.

title: Ken Paxton’s Financial Disclosures Appear to Violate Federal Ethics Law, Experts Say
content:
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton appears to have violated federal ethics law in significant ways when filing recent disclosures of his assets and liabilities, creating confusion about his net worth and holdings, a review by ProPublica and The Texas Tribune found.

Among them: Paxton, the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate, reported owning seven homes but said he earned no income from any. Yet all but one was listed for rent during the reporting periods, and some current residents and neighbors at those addresses confirmed that the properties were rented, the news organizations found. Receiving income and not reporting it is a violation of federal disclosure law, three ethics experts said. 

Additionally, Paxton did not disclose mortgages for three condos at a Utah golf resort that federal law requires him to list as liabilities if they are not personal residences. 

He also valued his stake in a vacant plot of Texas land at up to $50,000 on last year’s filing, but his business partner told the newsrooms Paxton’s share for years has been worth about $1 million. Federal financial disclosure law requires property to be listed at fair market value.
snippet: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton appears to have violated federal ethics law in significant ways when filing recent disclosures of his assets and liabilities, creating confusion about his net worth

title: SAFAn blogi: Arkkitehdin koulutus antaa paljon, mutta toimijuus pitää rakentaa itse
content:
Työelämässä olevat tietävät, miten paljon työssä oppii sellaistakin, mistä ei opiskeluaikana kerrottu. Se ei ole virhe, sillä koulutuksen ei tarvitsekaan palvella kaikkia työelämän tarpeita. Arkkitehdin toimijuuden rakentuminen on kuitenkin asia, jonka toivoisin nousevan nykyistä paremmin esiin jo opintojen aikana.

Arkkitehdin toimijuudella tarkoitan kykyä tunnistaa ja käyttää omia vaikutusmahdollisuuksia vastuullisesti – niin työelämässä, yhteiskunnassa kuin opintojen piirissäkin. Arkkitehti ei ole vain toimeksiantojen toteuttaja, vaan ammattilainen, jonka tekemät ratkaisut vaikuttavat ihmisten arkeen, ympäristöön ja yhteiskuntaan.

Vahva ammattitaito ei synny pelkästään suunnittelun teknisestä osaamisesta. Ammattilaisen pitää myös ymmärtää, milloin omaa asiantuntemustaan kannattaa käyttää yhteisen hyvän edistämiseksi.

Opiskelijana omaa toimijuutta voi harjoittaa myös ilman suoraa yhteyttä työelämään tai opintoihin, esimerkiksi opiskelija- ja paikallislehdissä, kaupunkikehitysteemojen, metsäkiistojen tai yliopistopolitiikan parissa.

title: The axis and the alternative
content:
90 years ago, in July 1936, the Bayreuth opera festival featured Richard Wagner’s Siegfried, as it had many times before and since. After this performance, however, one of the festival’s regular guests, who was the leader of Germany at the time, received two envoys from the Spanish nationalist general Francisco Franco. As a result, Germany helped Franco to attack the Spanish Republic from Morocco, and later, Italy also provided massive military support to the fascist forces to wage a civil war on the democratic Republic, which lasted almost three years. 

In 1936, the emerging Italo-German axis sought to suppress, in particular, the possibility that a broad democratic coalition (‘popular front’) would implement social reform in Spain and represent an alternative to their retrograde, violent and chauvinistic politics in the eyes of Europeans. In interwar Europe, democracy was young and fragile. In Italy, it was not given a proper chance. In Germany, in 1933, once the Great Depression destabilised economic and social relations, it was easy to sweep aside the Weimar Republic. The fascists in Germany and Italy even felt they were entitled to impose their views in other countries as well.

title: Climate change images are getting scarier – could fear help drive action?
content:
Over the summer, Europe provided a stark new set of images of climate change. Wildfires raced across forests and grasslands, rivers and reservoirs dried up in droughts and extreme heat disrupted everyday life.

Instead of the familiar photographs of people enjoying days at the beach, coverage of heatwaves increasingly comes with images of their consequences.

Moreover, issues such as drought and the knock-on challenges for water conservation and food security are not reserved for distant countries, but now the impacts are unmistakably at home on our own doorstep. Tragically, this has also resulted in the loss of life and property.

How these effects are depicted through images, like the photographs we have been seeing in the media, matter for how people think about and act around climate change. This raises questions regarding how climate fallout in the UK and Europe is visually communicated through images and what affects these images may have on their viewers.

Images can be powerful communicative tools as they can be “read” more quickly than text and can sometimes be more emotionally evocative in ways that might also inspire action.

title: ”Luontokuvaajan vastuu ei liity ainoastaan siihen, miten kuva otetaan, vaan myös siihen, millaisen käsityksen luonnosta kuva välittää”
content:
Tiesitkö, että luontokuvallakin on Suomessa oma festivaali? Se järjestetään Kuusamossa 31. kertaa, nyt Kuusamotalossa ja Oulangan kansallispuiston kupeessa osana Oulu 2026-kulttuuripääkaupunkivuotta.

Samalla Oulangan kansallispuisto viettää 70-vuotissyntymäpäiväänsä.

Tämän vuoden teema on Kohti luontoa, ja sen kautta tekijät pohtivat suhdettaan luontoon ja erilaisia tapoja lähestyä ja ymmärtää sitä.

Luontokuvaajien lisäksi mukana on tutkijoita, kirjailijoita ja taiteilijoita.

”Tutkija voi tarkastella samaa ympäristöä eri näkökulmasta kuin valokuvaaja, kirjailija tai taiteilija. Parhaimmillaan nämä täydentävät toisiaan. Festivaalille ei siis tarvitse tulla luontokuvaajana tai edes valokuvauksen harrastajana. Toiveenamme on, että ohjelma tarjoaa ajatuksia jokaiselle luonnosta kiinnostuneelle”, festivaalin taiteellinen johtaja Jonna Kalliomäki sanoo.

 Kalliomäen mukaan luontokuvaus elää kiinnostavaa mutta ristiriitaista aikaa.

”Luontokuvia tehdään ja nähdään enemmän kuin koskaan, ja samalla kuvattava luonto on monin paikoin yhä suuremman paineen alla”, hän sanoo.

title: Xi, Putin and Modi looking in different directions as Shanghai Cooperation Organisation marks 25th anniversary
content:
The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) marked its 25th anniversary in Bishkek, the capital of Kyrgyzstan, with all the trappings a diplomatic milestone demands.

There were 21 heads of state and government present for a ceremonial “family photo” and two-page Bishkek Declaration on September 1. A further 28 agreements included “strengthening multilateral partnership in nuclear safety and nuclear security”.

On the face of it, the SCO appeared to be a confident bloc speaking with one voice for roughly a quarter of humanity, while representing between 23% and 25% of global GDP.

Shanghai Cooperation Organisation countries:

The real picture, however, is far less flattering. A quarter of a century in, it remains primarily a forum for multiple parallel bilateral engagements and deals between leaders. So far, so functional.

What the SCO has never become in 25 years is a body able to adjudicate the disputes its members bring to the room – still less, the ones they wage outside.

title: Ulkoministeri Valtonen asettaa asiantuntijaryhmän selvittämään tekoälyn ulko- ja turvallisuuspoliittisia vaikutuksia
content:
Ulkoministeri Elina Valtonen asettaa kansainvälisistä ja suomalaisista asiantuntijoista koostuvan työryhmän selvittämään tekoälyn ulko- ja turvallisuuspoliittisia vaikutuksia Suomelle. Työryhmä luovuttaa raporttinsa marraskuun loppuun mennessä.

Työryhmän toimeksiantona on hahmotella Suomen ulko- ja turvallisuuspoliittisia mahdollisuuksia ja haasteita tekoälyn murroksessa sekä Suomen kansainvälisen aseman vahvistamista tekoälyn aikakaudella. Meillä keskustellaan paljon siitä, kuinka tekoäly muuttaa taloutta ja työelämää, mutta vaikutus kansainvälisiin voimasuhteisiin sekä valtioiden suvereeniteettiin ja turvallisuuteen on jäänyt vähemmälle huomiolle. Murrokseen liittyy niin uhkia kuin mahdollisuuksiakin, joita haluan nyt asiantuntijoiden kartoittavan päättäjiä varten”, ulkoministeri Valtonen sanoo.

title: THL: Vaihda ruutuaika luontoaikaan – jo 15 minuuttia riittää terveyshyötyihin
content:
Terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin laitoksen (THL) koordinoima Terveyttä luonnosta -ohjelma kannustaa suomalaisia lisäämään luonnossa vietettyä aikaa arjessaan. Tutkimusnäytön perusteella terveyteen ja hyvinvointiin liittyviä vaikutuksia voidaan havaita jo 10–15 minuutin luontokäyntien jälkeen.

Hyötyjen saamiseksi ei tarvitse lähteä erämaahan. Luontoajaksi lasketaan metsässä liikkumisen lisäksi esimerkiksi oleskelu puistossa, rannalla tai muussa viher- tai vesiympäristössä. Luonnossa voi liikkua, istua paikallaan tai tehdä esimerkiksi puutarhatöitä.

Lyhyiden luontohetkien vaikutukset näkyvät tutkimuksissa etenkin stressin lievittymisenä, mielialan paranemisena ja palautumisena. Hyötyjä kertyy THL:n mukaan sekä lyhyemmistä että pidemmistä luontokäynneistä, kun niitä toistetaan säännöllisesti.

title: Analysis: UK solar power hits record high over summer 2026
content:
Solar power generation in the UK reached a new record over the summer of 2026, as temperatures across the nation soared, according to new analysis by Carbon Brief. 

Collectively over June, July and August, solar farms and rooftops generated 8.8 terawatt-hours (TWh) of electricity in the UK*, as shown in the chart below. 

Speaking to Carbon Brief, Chris Hewett, chief executive of trade association Solar Energy UK welcomed the new record, adding that it was driven by “clear skies and continued growth in deployment”. 

This surge in generation took place amid the hottest summer on record in the UK, with five heatwaves between May and August.

Summer 2026 was the sixth sunniest on record, with more than 620 hours of sunshine, according to the Met Office. England and Wales – which experienced the most extreme heat – saw their second-sunniest summers on record. 

June 2026 was the hottest June in England since records began in 1884, according to Met Office data, while Wales and the UK as a whole experienced their second-warmest June.

title: Thieves target mail order sales as Pokémon card prices soar
content:
As one card recently sold for £12m, opportunistic thefts have surged – envelopes are being opened en route, costing small businesses thousands

Pokémon’s success over the last 30 years has seen it grow from a much-loved Game Boy classic, to a world-dominating brand with TV shows, spin-off games, toys and even a theme park. The trading card game is a huge part of that, with more than 85bn cards printed over its lifetime, and the appetite for them shows no signs of slowing down. Packs get snapped up after release so quickly it’s now almost impossible to find them in shops, and a booming resale market is driving the hobby into murky waters.

One card recently sold for an eye-watering £12m, and an increasing number of people have gotten into the collecting business on the hunt for huge profits, leading to a rise in thefts targeting card shops. More recently though, some small businesses have reported that their sales have been hit by thieves targeting envelopes within Royal Mail, leading to thousands in lost revenue.

title: Immigration and Firm Innovation: Evidence from Finnish Manufacturing
content:
This study examines the relationship between immigration and firm-level innovation in the Finnish manufacturing sector. The analysis exploits unique matched data linking employees’ immigration status with firm-level patenting, process and product innovation activities, and innovation inputs. To address the potential endogeneity of firms’ immigrant employment, a newly developed instrumental variables approach is applied, using the predicted historical geographic distribution of immigrants as an instrument. The results show that immigrant employment positively affects firms’ patenting activity and the number of R&D workers, with these effects being statistically significant only among more productive firms. Furthermore, firms with a higher concentration of non-native employees exhibit stronger immigration-innovation effects, suggesting that the mechanisms linking immigration and innovation may depend on the scale and stage of immigration. Finally, the study finds that immigration enhances firm growth and boosts native employment.

Research Policy, Vol. 55, Issue 10, 3 September 2026 (online).

title: Mitä pakolaistaustaisista nuorista miehistä tiedetään? Tutkija nostaa uutuuskirjassa valokeilaan nuorten haastavan arjen Suomessa
content:
Pakolaistaustaisten nuorten miesten tapa olla julkisessa tilassa nähdään usein häiritsevänä hälinänä. Heillä on kuitenkin sanottavaa suomalaisesta yhteiskunnasta ja heidän ääntään tulisi kuunnella. Nuorten kanssa yli kymmenen vuotta kulkenut Elina Niinivaara kuvaa teoksessaan Kenen koti, kenen katu? Pakolaistaustaiset nuoret miehet ja haastava arki, miten he toimivat muuttaakseen asemaansa Suomessa ja vaikuttaakseen yhteiskunnalliseen ilmapiiriimme.

Kaduilla, kouluissa, urheilukentillä sekä lehdissä ja sosiaalisessa mediassa pakolaistaustaiset nuoret miehet nähdään maahanmuuttajina ja pakolaisina, ei yksilöinä. Julkisessa keskustelussa nuoret kuvataan riskeinä suomalaiselle yhteiskunnalle ja itselleen, toisaalta yhteiskunnallisesti passiivisina. Keitä he todella ovat?

”Nuorten arkisia kohtaamisia varjostavat maahanmuuttajan hahmo, haavoittuvan pakolaisnuoren arkkityyppi sekä ’hyvän maahanmuuttajan’ ihanne. Heidät asetetaan johonkin näistä kolmesta asemasta toistuvasti ja kysymättä, usein luultavasti asiaa sen kummemmin ajattelematta”, Elina Niinivaara kertoo.

title: Katrina – musiikkiteatteri
content:
Otteita Katrina-musiikkiteatteriteoksesta
Stina Ekblad lukee otteita Sally Salmisen romaanista Katrina.

Aika: Sunnuntaina 4.10.2026 klo 14.00–15.30
Paikka: Suomen Tukholman-instituutti, Snickarbacken 4, Tukholma
Pääsy: Vapaa pääsy, mutta ennakkoilmoittautuminen on pakollinen. Ilmoittaudu tämän linkin kautta.

Katrina – musiikkiteatteri on voimakas ja koskettava musiikkiteos, joka perustuu Sally Salmisen samannimiseen klassikkoromaaniin vuodelta 1936. Teos kertoo pohjalaisesta maalaistytöstä Katrinasta, joka avioituu ahvenanmaalaisen merimiehen kanssa ja muuttaa Ahvenanmaan karuun saaristoympäristöön.

Vierailuesityksessä nähdään erityisesti tätä tilaisuutta varten valmistettu kamariversio solisteille ja pianolle. Tämän lyhyemmän version käsikirjoituksesta ja ohjauksesta vastaa Ida Kronholm. Musiikin on säveltänyt ahvenanmaalainen säveltäjä Jack Mattsson, joka sävelsi myös alkuperäisen laajamittaisen Musikteater Katrina -teoksen orkesterille, kuorolle ja solisteille vuonna 1997 Ahvenanmaan itsehallinnon 75-vuotisjuhlavuoden yhteydessä.

title: US court ruling aggravates Brussels’ Google problem
content:
BRUSSELS — How do you solve a monopoly like Google’s?

It’s a question that has beset Brussels for the past year, ever since the European Commission fined the search giant €2.95 billion for monopolizing the vast market for digital advertising. A few months earlier, in April 2025, a U.S. judge had also found Google guilty in a lawsuit brought by the Department of Justice, as parallel investigations on both sides of the Atlantic finally ran their course.

On Wednesday, however, the same U.S. judge made the European Commission’s life a lot more difficult.

In a ruling from Washington’s own attempt to break up Google, Judge Leonie Brinkema, of the Federal District of Eastern Virginia, rejected the DoJ’s request for a forced divestiture of parts of its business.

That decision leaves the EU alone, at a time of transatlantic discord, in advocating that the online advertising giant break itself up.

“It’s obvious that the European Commission has been holding out for a decision in the parallel U.S. case, even if it has the authority to act independently and should have done so long ago,” Max von Thun, Europe director at the Open Markets Institute non-profit, told POLITICO.

title: Tunisia: Upheld convictions in mass ‘conspiracy case’ a travesty of justice

By validating these draconian sentences, ranging up to 45 years, following a sham trial based on unfounded charges, the authorities have doubled down on their relentless campaign to eliminate political dissent and silence independent voices.

title: Cameroon’s indomitable Lionesses football team finally shatter WAFCON glass ceiling
content:
Cameroon joins the ranks of WAFCON winners: Nigeria (10), Equatorial Guinea (2), and South Africa (1).

Originally published on Global Voices

Image of the Cameroonian women’s football team. Screenshot from the video “Cameroon – Women’s CAN: The Undaunted Lionesses Crowned Champions of Africa” on the Africa 24 YouTube Channel.

After losing three finals, the Cameroonian women’s football team has finally lifted the Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON). Their victory over Malawi in Rabat (the capital of Morocco) on August 16, 2026, stands as a testament to this generation’s perseverance and the progressive transformation of African women’s football.

For more than two decades, Cameroon has had a reputation for being a powerhouse in African women’s football, but they had never been able to go all the way and snag the coveted WAFCON trophy. However, Sunday, August 16, at the Moulay El Hassan Stadium, told an entirely different story. In the 2026 TotalEnergies Women’s Africa Cup of Nations final, the indomitable Lionesses beat Malawi 3–0, clinching their first-ever continental title.

title: Cambodia: Legal Revisions Reinforce One-Party Rule
content:
(Bangkok, September 4, 2026) – The Cambodian government should withdraw proposed legal amendments that would drastically reduce opposition party representation in top positions on local councils, Human Rights Watch said today. 

On August 20, 2026, the Cambodian National Assembly, which is dominated by the Cambodian People’s Party (CPP), unanimously passed amendments to the Law on the Administration and Management of Commune/Sangkat. The changes to four articles in the law determine the apportionment of elected local council positions across Cambodia’s more than 1,600 communes. The Senate approved the amendments on September 4, which will be in effect for the next commune elections, slated for June 2027.

“The new amendments to Cambodia’s commune law, combined with the ruling party’s other repressive measures, appear aimed at eliminating opposition influence and cementing one-party rule at the local level,” said Bryony Lau, deputy Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “The Cambodian People’s Party is forever seeking to minimize if not eliminate the role of opposition politicians in the country’s rule.”

title: Regulators Knew This Marijuana Product Was Harming People. It Stayed on Shelves for More Than a Year.
content:
In March 2022, Colorado public health officials started getting startling reports of liver damage tied to a new marijuana-based sleep aid that had quickly become a top seller in the state.

But it wasn’t until June 2023, nearly 15 months later, that the state’s Marijuana Enforcement Division would warn consumers that the danger had become so serious that the manufacturer had halted production of the sleep pills, called 1906 Midnight Drops, after more reports of “acute liver injury.”

The delay highlights a slew of weaknesses in the system for protecting consumers from hazardous products in the nation’s first regulated recreational marijuana market.

The health complaints had prompted the division to investigate, but the agency decided it didn’t have the power to pull the drops from the stores in this situation. If the agency had dug deeper, it might have found what the state attorney general’s office later discovered: The manufacturer, Sima Sciences, began receiving complaints of harm shortly after it launched 1906 Midnight Drops and two years before health officials ever did.

title: The pastry paradox: why are the Danes slimmer than Britons?
content:
Picture a cosy Danish living room. Candles flicker, soft music plays and friends and family gather around a table laden with pastries – flaky, buttery and gloriously calorific. This is hygge in action, and it seems almost tailor made to give any health conscious Briton a mild panic attack.

While Britons have spent decades being told that sugar and fat are dietary villains, the Danes appear to be cheerfully ignoring the memo and somehow remaining one of the slimmest nations in Europe, even though they consume 57kg of sugar annually per capita compared to the UK’s 44kg. We could call it “the pastry paradox”.

The very pastry that bears their name – the Danish – is a staple of British bakeries, airport lounges and sad desk breakfasts the nation over. And yet Danes are much less likely to be obese, with one in five having a body mass index (BMI) higher than 30, when one in three of their British counterparts are obese.

So what is going on? Let’s take a deeper look into trends in Britain, where obesity has steadily risen from around 15% in 1993, to around 29% in England, 32% in Scotland, and 26% in Wales in recent estimates.

title: A record-shattering El Niño is almost here. Here’s what that means for the world’s weather
content:
The world is bracing for the strongest El Niño in history.

The United Nations has made the grim prediction that our planet now sits in the “danger zone” of extreme weather. That’s based on data suggesting the current El Niño will break all previous records.

El Niño is a naturally occurring weather phenomenon that drives variations in temperature and winds across the Pacific Ocean and influences weather around the globe.

Globally, we have endured many strong El Niños in the past, but none have been as exceptionally strong and developed as quick as this one.

So what’s behind this potentially record-breaking El Niño? And how might it affect weather across the globe?

Scientists track El Niño activity using temperature data from the tropical Pacific Ocean near the equator. Historically, this involved measuring how high or low temperatures were across this region.

title: Tutkimus: Ilmastopolitiikkaan oppia kohtuuden rajoissa eläviltä
content:
Helsingin yliopistossa vastikään väitellyt Tina Nyfors on tutkinut, millainen elämäntapa ja yhteiskuntajärjestys mahdollistaisivat sekä pysymisen ympäristön kestokyvyn rajoissa että riittävän elintason kaikille. Tutkimuksessa nousee esiin niin kutsuttu "kohtuuden luokka": ihmiset, joiden hiilijalanjälki on maltillinen, mutta joiden perustarpeet silti täyttyvät.

Nyforsin mukaan tulos on merkittävä, koska se osoittaa, ettei kohtuudessa eläminen tarkoita automaattisesti luopumista – osa ihmisistä elää jo nyt tällä tavalla. Tutkimukseen osallistuneiden hiilijalanjälki oli selvästi keskivertosuomalaista pienempi.

Tutkimuksessa kohtuus määritellään niin sanotun kohtuuden käytävän avulla. Käytävällä on kaksi rajaa: ylärajan yli kuluttavat muodostavat ylikuluttavan luokan, kun taas alarajan alle jäävät elävät niukkuudessa ja kuuluvat aiemman tutkimuskirjallisuuden mukaan kamppailevaan luokkaan. Näiden kahden rajan väliin jäävä alue on kohtuuden käytävä, jossa elävät kuuluvat kohtuuden luokkaan.

title: How this summer’s heat and drought impacted crops in Europe – in six charts
content:
Farmers around Europe are dealing with the aftermath of a summer of extreme heat, drought and wildfires that were exacerbated by climate change. 

Human-caused climate change is increasing the severity and likelihood of many extreme weather events around the world, which is increasing volatility for food producers.

This summer resulted in, for example, shrunken potatoes in the Netherlands, reduced carrot harvests in France, dried-up rice fields in Italy and scorched olive groves in parts of the Mediterranean region.

Global food prices are currently at their highest level since early 2023 due to “heatwaves and energy price dynamics”, according to the UN Food and Agriculture Organization. 

Other factors such as blocked fertiliser supplies in the Strait of Hormuz and high fuel costs have also played a role in this year’s agricultural outputs. 

In the six charts below, Carbon Brief provides a snapshot of the impact this summer’s extremes are considered to have had on crop production and yields across Europe.

title: Strengthening Trust and Leadership: Reflections on National Institutes of Health (NIH) 2026 Community Days: Securing NIH Controlled-Access Data and Our Data Protection Journey | Data Science at NIH
content: "On April 13 and 14, I had the privilege of leading the National Institutes of Health (NIH) 2026 Community Days: Securing NIH Controlled-Access Data webinars to engage directly with our stakeholders, researchers, and the broader public about the critical work we’re undertaking to protect controlled-access data. These sessions were designed to foster transparency around our security and operational standards, update the community on new resources and requirements, and reinforce our shared responsibility in safeguarding participant trust. I am deeply grateful for the vibrant participation and thoughtful questions that were raised, which underscores the importance and urgency of our mission. Protecting participants’ trust requires one standard: secure, consistent protections for NIH controlled-access data—whether it is processed within a NIH Controlled-Access Data Repository (CADR) or a research institution’s IT systems. This principle drove the Extramural Community Days agenda, where we discussed not only what needs to be done, but why rigorous data protection is more essential than ever. Our commitment goes beyond compliance; it’s about honoring the trust participants place in us

title: Serbia’s Genocide Denial in Bosnia and Herzegovina
content:
Survivors’ groups in Bosnia and Herzegovina have condemned the announcement that the Serbian government plans to bury the convicted genocidaire Ratko Mladić with “highest military and state honors.” Mladić, the Bosnian Serb army chief during the Balkan wars of the early 1990s, died on August 27 in custody in The Hague following his 2017 conviction by the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) for war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide. His body was met by Serbian officials in Belgrade on September 3.

Mladić ‘s apprehension in 2011, after his 16 years on the run, remains a highlight of international cooperation to deliver justice. The European Union, in particular, played a critical role in securing Serbia’s cooperation with the ICTY as part of the country’s bid to join the EU.  

The ICTY judgment, upheld on appeal, makes clear Mladić's responsibility for widespread atrocities, including the Bosnian Serb army’s mass execution of at least 7,000 Bosnian Muslim men and boys in the Srebrenica genocide. Mladić was among the highest-level individuals tried before the ICTY and his trial was its last before it closed in 2017.

title: Feminist icon Gloria Steinem lifted up women everywhere, leaving behind a more gender-equal world
content:
Feminist activist Gloria Steinem has died aged 92.

Known almost as much for her trademark mid-parted hair and large aviator sunglasses as for her acute intelligence, courage and wit, she will long be known for setting feminist torches alight globally over her six-decade career as a journalist, activist and feminist icon.

Steinem has always been candid about the impact her early life had on the decisions she later made.

Ten years after she was born in Toledo, Ohio (March 25 1934), her parents divorced. Following the departure of her travelling salesman father, young Gloria was left taking care of her mentally ill mother until she graduated from high school and her sister took over.

Years later she reflected that she “became a grown-up too early, from ten to 17, a small person responsible for a big person”.

Rejecting marriage, she said she did not want to end up taking care of someone else (although much later, in 2000 at the age of 66, she did marry entrepreneur and activist David Bale, who died of lymphoma four years later).

title: India: Renewed Ethnic Violence in Manipur
content:
(New York, September 4, 2026) – Indian authorities should urgently address renewed violence between ethnic communities in the northeastern state of Manipur, Human Rights Watch said today. At least seven people were killed in late August 2026 in violence between the Naga and Kuki-Zo tribal communities in the state’s hill districts, leaving 34 dead since the current violence between the communities began in February. 

The recent clashes between the Naga and Kuki-Zo communities have expanded the ethnic violence that had earlier involved the predominant, mostly Hindu, Meitei community and the mostly Christian Kuki-Zo communities since May 2023, causing more than 260 deaths and more than 60,000 to be displaced. Since February, armed militant groups from both the Naga and Kuki-Zo communities have burned down homes in villages, taken hostages, blocked highways and engaged in gunfire. The Bharatiya Janata Party-led state government which came to office in February on the promise of peace and reconciliation, has taken inadequate measures to end the violence and provide security for both populations.

title: Warum Gewerkschaften und Betriebsräte wichtig für die Wikimedia Bewegung sind
content:
Im Juli 2026 gab „Wiki Workers United U.S.“ – eine Gruppe von Mitarbeitenden der Wikimedia Foundation, die eine Gewerkschaftsgründung anstrebt – bekannt: Sie haben die Wikimedia Foundation dazu aufgefordert, die „Communications Workers of America“ (CWA) freiwillig als ihre Gewerkschaftsvertretung anzuerkennen. Die Mitarbeitenden hatten dafür sogenannte Union Authorization Cards unterzeichnet.

„Wiki Workers United“ forderte die WMF daher auf, mit der CWA Verhandlungen aufzunehmen. Daraufhin schlug die Wikimedia Foundation Anfang August vor, zunächst eine geheime Abstimmung über die Frage der Gewerkschaftsgründung unter Aufsicht des National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) abzuhalten.

Dieses Vorgehen erzeugte Kritik. Der Vorwurf: Es handele sich dabei um eine Verzögerungstaktik, mit der die gewerkschaftliche Organisation der Mitarbeitenden verhindert werden soll.

Um eine Abstimmung für die Mitarbeitenden der WMF zu organisieren, wandte sich die Gewerkschaft CWA an das NLRB. Diese Bundesbehörde ist für die Überwachung der rechtmäßigen gewerkschaftlichen Organisation von Beschäftigten im privaten Sektor zuständig. Die Abstimmung wird am 3. September. abgeschlossen sein.

title: Wikimedia Foundation Statement on US staff unionization
content:
3 September 2026 (United States) — Today, eligible Wikimedia Foundation staff in the United States voted in favor of union representation. The election was conducted by the National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) by secret ballot. We expect the results will be certified by the NLRB within 7 business days.

Throughout the voting period, staff were able to meet and organize during working hours without restriction, and Wikimedia Foundation leadership repeatedly affirmed staff’s right to decide for themselves whether union representation was right for them. The Foundation respects this outcome and is glad that all eligible staff had the opportunity to participate and make their voices heard.

The Foundation will now move forward with good-faith collective bargaining with the union. We will approach this next phase constructively, lawfully, and with care for the staff whose work makes it possible for us to serve people everywhere.

title: Isän työpaikan menetys nuoruudessa vähentää poikien todennäköisyyttä saada lapsia – Etlan Krista Riukulan tutkimus julkaistiin arvostetussa journaalissa
content:
Nuoruudessa koetulla vanhemman työpaikan menetyksellä voi olla kauaskantoisia seurauksia lapsen perheenperustamiseen aikuisena, osoittaa Elinkeinoelämän tutkimuslaitoksen vanhemman tutkijan Krista Riukulan tutkimus. Isän työpaikan menetys vähentää erityisesti poikien myöhempää todennäköisyyttä saada lapsia ja viivästyttää tyttärien lastensaantia. Äidin työpaikan menetys näyttää aikaistavan tyttärien lastensaantia ilman vaikutusta lopulliseen lapsilukuun. Poikien kohdalla tulokset viittaavat hieman suurempaan lastensaannin todennäköisyyteen, mutta vaikutusta ei voida arvioida yhtä tarkasti. Tutkimus julkaistiin arvostetussa kansainvälisessä journaalissa.

Etlan vanhemman tutkijan Krista Riukulan tutkimus Childhood shocks and fertility: evidence from parental job loss on julkaistu vertaisarvioidussa journaalissa Journal of Population Economics. Riukulan tutkimus tarkastelee, millaisia vaikutuksia nuoruudessa koetuilla taloudellisilla shokeilla on perheenmuodostukseen. Tutkimus hyödyntää Suomen 1990-luvun alkupuoliskon laman ajan laajoja rekisteriaineistoja.

content: Abstract: Introduction: Scholarly communities are experiencing increased emphasis on research data sharing and reuse. Given the range of available data repositories and variability in the use of persistent identifiers (PIDs) for individuals and institutions, aggregating datasets by researchers at a specific institution is a significant challenge. We developed a reproducible workflow to evaluate 1) data repository use by researchers at our institutions, 2) metrics of reuse, and 3) quality of metadata records. Methods: We used the DataCite REST API to locate metadata records for datasets with creator affiliation names that matched our institutions. We performed substantial cleaning and deduplication before comparing repository use, citations, usage metrics, and metadata completeness. title: Taidetestaajat ja Svenska Teatern saivat ansaitsemansa tuen budjettiriihessä
content:
Syksyn budjettiriihestä kuului merkittäviä ja toiveikkaita uutisia suomalaiselle kulttuurikentälle. Haluamme lausua lämpimät kiitokset hallitukselle tärkeistä päätöksistä, jotka vahvistavat niin nuorten kulttuurikasvatusta kuin maamme teatterikentän rakenteita.

Erityisen ilahduttavaa on hallituksen päätös varmistaa Taidetestaajat-toiminnan jatko 3,5 miljoonan euron rahoituksella lukuvuodelle 2027–2028. Taidetestaajat on hanke, joka vie jokaisen Suomen kahdeksasluokkalaisen korkeatasoisen taiteen ja kulttuurin pariin – usein ensimmäistä kertaa elämässä. Päätös takaa, että tuhannet nuoret pääsevät jatkossakin kokemaan taiteen voiman asuinpaikastaan tai taustastaan riippumatta.

Toinen historiallinen askel on Svenska Teaternin nostaminen Helsingin kansallisnäyttämöiden joukkoon 1.1.2029 alkaen. Ruotsinkielisellä kansallisteatterillamme on korvaamaton rooli maamme monikulttuurisessa perinnössä ja elävässä teatteritaiteessa. On hienoa nähdä, että hallitus varautuu lisäämään 2,6 miljoonaa euroa valtionrahoitukseen kansallisten taidelaitosten toimintaan vuosien 2028–2031 julkisen talouden suunnitelmassa.

title: Maisemapäivän valokuvakilpailu kutsuu pohtimaan maiseman merkitystä luonnon ja ihmisen hyvinvoinnille
content:
Maisemapäivän vuoden 2026 valokuvakilpailu on käynnistynyt. Kilpailu kutsuu tarkastelemaan, miten viherympäristöt, kuten pihat, lähimetsät ja puistot, tukevat luonnon monimuotoisuutta ja ihmisten hyvinvointia. Voittaja julkistetaan kansainvälisenä maisemapäivänä 20. lokakuuta.

Suomessa kansainvälistä maisemapäivää juhlistetaan muun muassa valokuvakilpailulla ja maisemakävelyillä. Tänä vuonna valokuvakilpailun teemana on Hyvinvointi rakentuu elävässä ympäristössä. Kilpailu kannustaa tarkastelemaan etenkin pihojen, lähimetsien, puistojen ja muiden viherympäristöjen merkitystä osana maisemaa.

Viherympäristöjen suunnittelu, suojelu ja hoito vaikuttavat sekä luonnon monimuotoisuuteen että ihmisten hyvinvointiin ja elämänlaatuun. Kilpailu kutsuu huomaamaan myös tutussa maisemassa paikkoja ja piirteitä, jotka tekevät siitä elävän, viihtyisän ja luonnoltaan monimuotoisen.

”Maisemat ovat osa kulttuuriperintöä, ihmisten identiteettiä sekä elinympäristön laadun perustaa. Valokuvakilpailu kannustaa pysähtymään tuttujen maisemien äärelle ja huomaamaan, miten luonnon ja ihmisten hyvinvointi kietoutuvat niissä yhteen”, sanoo erityisasiantuntija Martina Reinikainen ympäristöministeriöstä.

title: Aikamatka Paimioon - Mitä Isojakokartat kertovat yli 200 vuoden takaisesta maisemasta?
content:
Tänä kesänä lähdin aikamatkalle Paimioon korkeakouluharjoittelun muodossa. Pääsin tutustumaan harjoittelussani 1700- ja 1800-lukujen taitteen isojakokarttoihin, joista luodaan digitaalista maisemahistoria-aineistoa. Nopeasti opin, etteivät kartat ole pelkkiä pölyisiä paperinpalasia vaan täynnä tarinoita ja yllättäviäkin yksityiskohtia. Kesän aikana Paimiosta on digitoitu karttoja noin kahden kolmasosan alueelta. Kun työ valmistuu ja aineisto julkaistaan, vanhojen karttojen sisältämiä tietoja pääsee kuka vain tarkastelemaan ja vertailemaan nykyiseen maisemaan.

Ensimmäinen haaste oli ymmärtää, mitä isojakokartat oikeastaan ovat. Isojako oli Ruotsissa ja Suomessa toimitettu maanjakotoimitus. Sen tehtävänä oli poistaa sarkajako ja yhdistää kapeat harvat sarat lohkoiksi sekä jakaa kylän maat talojen kesken. Tuolloin luodut rajat näkyvät vielä tämänkin päivän kiinteistörajoissa. Isojakokartat kuvaavat ennen kaikkea niittyjä ja peltoja. Lisäksi jokainen talon tontti, rakennus ja kasvimaa on merkitty karttaan. Kartoista löytyy myös torppia, hakoja, kirkkoja, aitoja, eri kokoisia teitä ja polkuja, mäkiä, kuoppia ja rajapyykkejä.

title: FIME to Visit Riyadh This Autumn
content:
This autumn, the Finnish Institute in the Middle East (FIME) will spend the autumn in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. During the four-month visit, FIME’s personnel will deepen their knowledge of the Gulf region, strengthen academic networks and explore new opportunities for cooperation.

FIME will organise a range of activities in Riyadh, including two academic workshops, public lectures, and a student course focusing on the ancient history of Saudi Arabia.

The Embassy of Finland in Riyadh has generously offered FIME workspace for the duration of the visit. FIME was invited to Saudi Arabia by the Gulf Research Center, while the Embassy of Saudi Arabia in Helsinki has assisted with the practical arrangements. The King Faisal Center for Research and Islamic Studies (KFCRIS) will provide seminar facilities for FIME’s events.

FIME warmly thanks all the organisations involved for their support and for making the visit possible!

content:

title: Wes Anderson Picks Nine of His Favorite Criterion Films
content:
Many an internet cinephile has wondered aloud if the Criterion Closet is a real place, or just a set thrown together to make videos when famous directors like Christopher Nolan, Francis Ford Coppola, or Jim Jarmusch drop by. It turns out indeed to exist, not only at Criterion’s offices in New York, but also elsewhere. The Criterion Mobile Closet, for example, has taken the label’s home-video library on the road since 2024, the 40th anniversary of the company’s foundation. If it comes to your town, queue up in as timely a fashion as possible, and you may get the chance to enter and remain inside for three minutes. That may sound brief, but no less an auteur than Wes Anderson takes almost a minute less to make his cinematic selections in the new video above.

The occasion was the Criterion Mobile Closet’s stop at the Hollywood Bowl, which coincided with the three-night concert event Music from the Films of Wes Anderson this past June. With a few days’ travel ahead of him, he picks out nine Criterion releases as viewing material to take along on “our road trip across America.”

title: Answer all your questions about university entry — with Freedom of Information
content:
Every year from around April to September, we see an uptick on people sharing links to our Freedom of Information site, WhatDoTheyKnow on Reddit forums. The reason? It’s the peak time for anxieties around university entry.

As we know, universities are generally looking for the brightest of minds. Perhaps that includes those who have enough initiative to source data around things like their entry requirements and shortlisting criteria. 

As public bodies, universities are subject to the Freedom of Information Act, so a lot of this data can be requested; and where people have used WhatDoTheyKnow to do so, the responses are publicly available for other potential students to access in years to come.

So what kind of information are these bright sparks asking for? In a brief analysis, we came across requests which address seven distinct questions for university applicants. 

Forward planning never hurts, and for some smart kids this comes into play as early as Year 11. 

“Does a fourth A-level help you get into the Computer Science course at a top-level university?”, asked a student who was about to pick their sixth form subjects.

title: Court Rules Against Citizen Journalists in DMCA Takedown Case—EFF Will Appeal
content:
A federal court in Massachusetts has ruled that copyright holders can issue online takedown notices based on a subjective belief of copyright infringement, even when that belief is unreasonable and self-serving. The case was brought by our client, Channel 781 News, after takedown notices temporarily shut down the citizen journalism group's YouTube channel. We think the court set the bar far too low for copyright takedowns, and we plan to appeal.

Channel 781 is a group of independent, volunteer journalists who report on local affairs in Waltham, Massachusetts. That includes posting short, newsworthy excerpts from recordings of city government meetings produced by Waltham Community Access Corporation (WCAC), the city's public access television station.

In September 2023, WCAC sent three copyright takedown notices to YouTube targeting fifteen of Channel 781's videos. YouTube removed the videos and, under its three-strikes policy, temporarily disabled Channel 781's entire account—just days before a local election.

title: Hungary poised to rejoin flagship EU research program
content:
PRAGUE— Hungary said Thursday it is on track to rejoin the EU’s flagship research program, Horizon Europe, potentially unlocking millions in European funding that had been blocked under former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán.

Hungarian Science and Tech Minister Zoltán Tanács told POLITICO that all legal barriers to accessing EU research funding have been cleared by changing how its higher education is governed, meeting the technical criteria agreed upon with Brussels.

“Legally, we are back again,” Tanács said, speaking on the sidelines of the Central and Eastern Europe Artificial Intelligence Summit in Prague. “We have restructured our university management. We have eliminated all those strange structures that have been set up by the former government.”

A European Commission spokesperson said Brussels has “not been formally notified yet” by Hungary.

title: Americas: Amnesty International opens Virtual Museum exploring more than six decades of human rights activism
content:
Amnesty International presents Stories That Resist, its first Virtual Museum—an immersive 360° experience that allows visitors to explore 65 years of campaigning, research and collective action in defence of human rights around the world.

Across five thematic galleries, visitors can explore more than 50 historical items, including emblematic objects from Amnesty International’s archives, campaigns that defined generations, photographs, videos, awards and testimonies from people who chose to act in the face of injustice.

“The history of Amnesty International is made up of people who refused to remain indifferent. This museum allows us to honour their courage, preserve the memory of our struggles and remind ourselves that every action, however small it may seem, can help transform a life,” said Ana Piquer, Amnesty International’s Regional Director for the Americas.

title: Prominent Niger Journalist Feared Forcibly Disappeared
content:
Three days have passed since the prominent Nigerien journalist Moussa Kaka went missing, raising fears that he may have been forcibly disappeared.

Kaka, director-general of Radio Télévision Saraounia and a former correspondent for Radio France Internationale, left his office in Niamey, the capital, at around 7 p.m. on August 31 to return home. Since then, his family and colleagues have been unable to obtain any information about his whereabouts.

Kaka has previously faced pressure from the authorities. In October 2025, police in Niamey arrested him and five other journalists—Abdoul Aziz Idé, Ibro Chaibou, Souleymane Brah, Youssouf Seriba and Oumarou Kané—after they announced via social media a news briefing about a solidarity fund the government had created to raise money to support state security force operations. The authorities charged them with “complicity in distributing documents likely to disturb public order” under the cybercrime law. In November, a court released Kaka, Idé and Brah on bail, while Seriba and Kané were released on July 15, and Chaibou on August 28.

title: 25 Years Ago, 9/11 Triggered a U.S. Crusade of Torture
content:
By Norman Solomon*

SAN  FRANCISCO | 3 September 2026 (IDN) — A quarter-century has passed since the terrorist attack that killed almost 3,000 people in the United States on Sept. 11, 2001. During the first seven years after that mass atrocity, Pentagon spending doubled. The aftermath of 9/11 was also a huge boost for “the intelligence community.” Despite – and because of – their failure to prevent the carnage on that day, the CIA and the National Security Agency as well as 14 smaller spy agencies boomed with enormous jolts of funds.

Along the way, some line items paid for torture that persisted during the George W. Bush presidency under the euphemism of “enhanced interrogation techniques.”

title: Minister tells Brits to stock up on days of supplies after ‘supersize’ El Niño warning
content:
Exclusive: Angela Eagle urges UK citizens to be ‘a bit more resilient’ as they plan for national emergencies

British people have been urged to have enough food and water on hand to survive a few days without power or water, as the UN said the El Niño climate phenomenon was “supersizing before our eyes”, exacerbating extreme weather events worldwide.

Forecasters say they are braced for the biggest El Niño in 1,000 years, bringing wildfires and floods to parts of the world, and the threat of a wet, stormy winter for the UK.

As the British government plans a campaign urging citizens to prepare for national emergencies, Angela Eagle told the Guardian the likelihood of a wild winter showed the importance of keeping supplies at home.

title: Flock Taught Cops How to Surveil No Kings Protesters
content:
Flock taught cops how they could surveil the No Kings protests and “small parades” using a mix of Flock’s technology and law enforcement’s own databases in a webinar last year. As Flock publicly downplays the power of its automated license plate camera network and highlights its use to solve violent crime, the company’s seemingly endless trove of webinars, training sessions, and blog posts show it offers far more invasive capabilities.

In the webinar, Flock’s director of market management Caity Peak explains how real time crime centers — which are police surveillance centers that utilize Flock cameras and other surveillance cameras — can be used for emergency response, but can also be used to surveil “established events” like 4th of July fireworks displays, parades, bike races, Mardi Gras, and protests. The webinar shows just how routine the idea of always-on surveillance has become, and how casually it is used during extremely innocuous events.

title: Bosnian Police Intercept 96 Migrants, Identify Two Suspected Smugglers
content:
Bosnia and Herzegovina's border police prevented 96 people from illegally crossing the country's border, the agency said in a statement Thursday.

The smuggling attempts were thwarted in two separate operations Wednesday in the town of Bistrica. During the afternoon, officers intercepted 63 people—40 from Pakistan and 23 from Bangladesh. Acting on orders from the state prosecutor’s office, investigators seized two boats and identified two suspected smugglers.

Later that evening, authorities intercepted another 33 people in the same town, including 18 from Afghanistan, 13 from Bangladesh and two from Pakistan. Police said the country's Service for Foreigners' Affairs was notified and the investigation remains ongoing.
